name: Dark Hollows
source:
Halloween night. The streets are alive with children and lights. But you’re different – you have a guide, an unsettling figure calling you ‘Jerry.’ 

Together, you move through the shadows, trick-or-treating in ways no child should. What begins as candy and costumes becomes something far darker…
translation:
万圣节之夜。街道上充满了孩子和灯光。但你不同——你有一个向导，一个叫你“杰瑞”的令人不安的人物。

你们一起穿过阴影，以小孩子不该有的方式玩“不给糖就捣蛋”的游戏。一开始的糖果和服装变得更加黑暗……
